column3: With respect to The Bluffs Mortgage Loan (5.0%), the Mortgage Loan refinanced the prior lender’s balance sheet loan (the “2022 Loan”) that had refinanced a loan originated and securitized in 2014 (the “2014 Loan”). According to the borrower sponsor, the 2014 Loan had struggled because of general mismanagement and the COVID 19 pandemic, and was transferred to special servicing in 2020 before title was sold through a foreclosure sale in 2021. The current sponsor purchased the Mortgaged Property in 2022 with the 2022 Loan.
